background.value: light grey, light blue, or white; plain, single color

head_height.value: 26-30mm chin to crown (ages 11+); face width 16-20mm excluding ears

file_spec.value: minimum 400 dpi resolution, color, sharp with sufficient contrast

expression_restriction.value: neutral expression, mouth closed, looking straight at camera

glasses_policy.value: permitted if eyes fully visible, lenses fully transparent, no glare or shadow

ears_visibility.value: ears need not be visible if full face width is shown

face_visibility.value: face fully visible and uncovered, eyes fully visible

headwear_policy.value: not permitted; exceptions for religious head coverings (plain, single color, contrasting background) and medical hair loss

accessories.value: earrings and facial piercings permitted; no reflection from accessories
